mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.2% over 3 consecutive months reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to compressed risk premia.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines by ≥0.1% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for 2 consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below 1% from prior month indicate consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days due to earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by ≥1.0% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 combined with CPIAUCSL above 210.0 indicates stagflationary pressure, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days due to profit margin compression.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 and CPIAUCSL > 210.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real sales (RSAFS) above 3-month moving average indicates strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through elevated earnings growth expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% for 3 consecutive months signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuation multiples and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increase above 5.0% and payrolls decline exceeding 0.5% from prior month indicate labor market weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days due to reduced corporate hiring.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS declines by >0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) combined with rising CPIAUCSL (>210.0) indicates supply shock regime, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through cost-push inflation.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 and CPIAUCSL > 210.0.
